WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) as count_per_type
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
type_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(count_per_type) as avg_count_all_types
  FROM matched_records
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT m.count_per_type, (m.count_per_type - t.avg_count_all_types) as excess
  FROM matched_records m
  CROSS JOIN type_stats t
  WHERE m.count_per_type > t.avg_count_all_types
)
SELECT AVG(count_per_type) as average_of_counts, AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: ordertune is not null for all orders that have matched risk/margin records; orders with null ordertune would be excluded from GROUP BY
